summary: Outcome-aligned shaping restored contact and raised held-out phase 2 from 33.3% to 94.9% and phase 3 from 1.4% to 12.0%, but all three finals missed the declared phase-4 gate. One legal player20-assisted episode killed Death Metal and entered Zone 2 on seed 85097; it is acquisition evidence, not normal-start promotion. Immediate post-freeze contact improved in every trial, rejecting actor-retention loss as the next target. Direct renewable damage is retired in favor of a separately declared reachable phase handoff with terminal-canceling visible-health potential.
